description:
Software purpose-built for planning and building teams. All the tools you need to assess, compare, annotate and approve digital plans.


New
- Added support for creating a related document to Ci Anywhere Create Copy
Changes
- Changed message bars to show the link destination in the status bar when the cursor is over a link
Fixes
- Fixed an occasional deadlock when logging a Trapeze Cloud error
- Fixed incorrect background colour of pressed buttons
- Fixed tooltips not showing for left side panel tabs
